dct_description_sm: Northern communities are growing rapidly and the need for new roads, as well as municipal and residential buildings is in constant demand. Located on sensitive permafrost, it is important that the dynamic of these regions be understood beforehand in order to better support community development and adaptation to climate change. This geodatabase was created to develop risk assessment maps to guide the development of new infrastructures in Akulivik. This data was used for Katerine Grandmont and Katryne Larrive's MSc projects.
dct_title_s: Surficial deposits and permafrost conditions of Puvirnituq village, Nunavik
